title: Emit repo-relative path on task view/list JSON records
description: lore-cli LCLI-428: lore sync drops hyperlinks from managed <!-- lore:tasks --> blocks because its adapter (src/adapters/quest.ts:607) already reads value.file ?? value.path, and quest never emits either. Decision made 2026-09-03 answering an opum-agent orchestrator query: emit path (not file) on both task view and task list, since lore already falls back to path with zero adapter change needed. Compute it from the already-known TaskLocation (tasks/completed/archive/tasks) using the same rule as the existing ownedPathForLocation helper (src/application/tasks/tasks.ts:577-578): .quest/${location}/${id}.json. Additive field only -- no TRACKER_CONTRACT_VERSION bump, no change to required-field subset checks elsewhere.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest task view <id> --json includes data.path with the record's current repo-relative path (.quest/tasks/<id>.json, .quest/completed/<id>.json, or .quest/archive/tasks/<id>.json depending on status)
quest task list --json includes path on every list item using the same rule, with no extra filesystem I/O beyond what list already does
src/contract/tracker/index.ts required-fields manifests (and matching fixtures) list path for both task list and task view

A code comment or doc note states path reflects current location and can change when a task's status moves it across directories -- callers that persist it (e.g. rendered links) must expect staleness after such a transition
Existing task view/list tests pass plus new coverage asserting the correct path for a task in each of the three locations
